Amontillado sherry.name: Lustau Amontillado
Amontillado sherry.description: Amontillado sherry from Emilio Lustau in Jerez, Spain. Aged under flor then exposed to air. Nutty, dry, complex with hazelnut, brioche, and saline notes.

Prosecco.name: Nino Franco Rustico
Prosecco.description: Premium Prosecco from Nino Franco in Valdobbiadene. Glera grapes from historic vineyards. Fresh pear, white peach, and mineral notes. Dry finish.

Orange curaçao.name: Pierre Ferrand Dry Curaçao
Orange curaçao.description: Premium dry curaçao from Pierre Ferrand in Cognac. Made from dried Caraçao oranges, cognac base, and sugar. Dry, bitter-orange profile with honey and spice.

Geneva gin.name: Rutte Genever
Geneva gin.description: Dutch genever from Rutte Distillery. Malt-forward, malty, and rounded with juniper and citrus. Good bridge between whisky and gin.

Cherry liqueur.name: Luxardo Maraschino
Cherry liqueur.description: Premium Italian cherry liqueur from Marasca cherries. Complex with cherry, almond, spice, and herbal notes. 32% ABV.

Drambuie.name: Drambuie
Drambuie.description: Scottish honey-herbal liqueur. Scotch whisky base with heather honey, herbs, and spices. 40% ABV.

Absinthe.name: Pernod Absinthe
Absinthe.description: French absinthe from Pernod Fils. High-proof anise-flavored spirit with wormwood, anise, and fennel. Turns cloudy with water. 68% ABV.

Orange bitters.name: Regans' Orange Bitters No. 6
Orange bitters.description: Classic orange bitters from cocktail authority Gary Regan. Citrusy and aromatic. Lighter than Angostura.

Fino sherry.name: Tio Pepe Fino
Fino sherry.description: Classic fino sherry from González Byass. Lightest, driest sherry style. Pale, saline, almond, and green apple.

Irish cream.name: Baileys Irish Cream
Irish cream.description: Irish cream liqueur with Irish whiskey, cream, and chocolate. Smooth, sweet, 17% ABV.

Maraschino liqueur.name: Luxardo Maraschino
Maraschino liqueur.description: Premium Italian maraschino liqueur from Marasca cherry pits. Complex cherry, almond, spice. 32% ABV.

Triple sec.name: Cointreau
Triple sec.description: Premium French triple sec. Clean orange flavor, 40% ABV, dry finish. The standard for classic cocktails.

Heavy cream.name: Heavy cream
Heavy cream.description: High-fat dairy cream, usually 36–40% fat. Used for body and richness in shaken cocktails.

Simple syrup.name: Simple syrup
Simple syrup.description: Equal parts sugar and water, dissolved. The standard neutral sweetener for cocktails.

Orange liqueur.name: Pierre Ferrand Dry Curaçao
Orange liqueur.description: Premium dry curaçao from Pierre Ferrand in Cognac. Dry, bitter-orange profile with honey and spice.
